name: omp-turn-timestamps
description: Native Oh My Pi plugin that records per-turn timestamps and optional per-tool execution timings without adding them to model context.

omp.name: Turn Timestamps
omp.description: Shows per-turn timestamps and optional tool_call-to-tool_result execution timings.

showTurnTiming.description: Show absolute start/end timestamps and elapsed time for each OMP turn.

showToolTiming.description: Show tool_call-to-tool_result start/end timestamps and elapsed time for each tool execution.
